title: Golden Path Run Inspector
purpose: Ship one polished experience that proves the Locaily thesis: readiness -> example run -> capability steps -> decisions -> validation/evidence -> optional human gate -> exportable artifact
problem: Architecture is deep but outsiders cannot feel it. There is no single golden path that hides plumbing and shows capability routing, validation, and evidence.

included: Single Run Inspector surface (extend /console or thin shell) with: readiness check, built-in example, live step timeline, worker/why decisions, validator/evidence status, plain-language failures, standard vs AI comparison when available, human review inbox hook, artifact export
Default demo using existing Lighthouse fixture path
Works without PageSpeed API key, Relay Nodes, Memory Bridge, live website
Deterministic fixture path that works without Ollama when possible
Visible answers to: what is happening, who handled it, why this worker, did it pass, what failed, what AI changed, what requires me, what came out
Console validation UI updates so the path is testable locally
excluded: New second workflow beyond Lighthouse demo

acceptanceCriteria.description: User can open Locaily console, run built-in example, and reach a finished artifact without editing config or calling raw JSON APIs
Deterministic fixture path completes without PageSpeed key, Relay, Memory Bridge, or live site
Run Inspector shows step, worker, routing/qualification reason, pass/fail, failure next-step, human gate if any, and export action
Documented path exists to complete demo without Ollama using fixtures/deterministic mode, or clearly labels AI-enhanced steps as optional
Automated test or console validation path covers the fixture golden path
